title: Fiber Checker
intro: The Space reads open-data meshes and CT by URL and keeps none of it; here are the same sources for your own tools, and the page's API and MCP server, which checks any segment with the free judge.

sources.title: A traced segment's mesh: PHerc0500P2 z_dbg_gen_00440 on the 2.215 um scan
sources.note: x.tif, y.tif and z.tif in the scan's level-0 voxels. fiber.tif from a check has the same grid, so it lines up vertex for vertex.

sources.title: The CT that mesh is on, PHerc0500P2 2.215 um
sources.note: Read live from the open-data bucket, never copied here. The free judge reads level 2 of the 2.2 to 2.4 um scans (about 9 um).

sources.title: Check any segment, from code or an agent
sources.license: Code and weights Apache 2.0; scans and meshes CC BY-NC 4.0
sources.note: check_segment (sample, segment, volume, patches) runs the free judge on the Space's CPU, about two minutes for 60 patches. Model output, not a reading.
